meta.source: digest-verified read-only replays of recorded Phase 2E.0 episodes (replay_obs.mjs); no model trained, fitted or modified

thresholds.similarState: |Δ own purse share| ≤ 0.05, |Δ squad| ≤ 1, |Δ overseas| ≤ 1, same keeper need

definition.separation: |2·AUC − 1| between Stage-B and Stage-A learner observations in the same progress bin (0 = identical distributions, 1 = no overlap); AUC is the Mann–Whitney rank statistic
definition.highPressure: C4 rooms whose four RL opponents are D3QN or QR-DQN copies (largest Phase 2E.1 transfer loss)
definition.lowPressure: C4 rooms with four PPO copies
definition.support: Stage-A range = 0.5–99.5th percentile of each feature over Stage-A (A) learner observations on the same 40 entries
